reviewer: Pickle: official-source winter indoor humidity, cough duration classification, pharyngotonsillitis red flags, propolis regulatory status and trial, povidone-iodine label, platycodin and saline evidence, and Coupang product terms
method: Reviewed the draft against 17 sources on 2026-11-12. Humidity: the KDCA winter cold-wave health guide (updated 2026-06-02) sets indoor humidity at 40-50% and indoor temperature at 18-20 C, and states that dry indoor air dries the nasal and bronchial mucosa and can bring on respiratory and allergic disease; it also lists heating as the reason winter air dries out. The Ministry of Environment indoor air quality page puts comfort at 18-22 C and 40-60% and names heater operation as a humidity-lowering factor. Measurement: the KIEAE Journal 13(3) 2013 field survey of 20 Cheongju apartments (2010-12-28 to 2011-03-11) reports mean winter RH 35.4% (23.0-54.1%), with the 6 households under the 40% guideline averaging 26.7% and the paper stating that indoor RH below 30% dries skin and airway mucosa; the KJHE 20(1) 2011 survey of 5 senior halls in February 2009 reports 22.0-48.2% RH and links higher heated indoor temperature to drier air. Cough: the KDCA adult cough page (updated 2026-08-13) defines acute under 3 weeks, subacute 3-8 weeks and chronic over 8 weeks, names upper airway cough syndrome, cough variant asthma and GERD as the common chronic causes, gives CVA as 30-40% of chronic cough and GERD as 10-20% in the West with only 50-75% of reflux cough patients having reflux symptoms, and lists haemoptysis, purulent sputum, weight loss, night sweats and immunosuppression as warning signs. The KDCA cold page (updated 2026-05-12) contains the sentence that wind, temperature and humidity have not been shown to worsen cold symptoms, so the article deliberately does not claim dry air causes colds; the same page states that when the pharynx damaged by a cold in the dry season does not recover, cough, sputum and throat foreign-body sensation can last more than 3 weeks, that symptoms peak on days 2-3 and that 7-10 days is the usual course. Pharyngotonsillitis: the KDCA page (updated 2026-05-18) gives bacterial causes in 30-40% of cases above age 5, peak incidence at 5-15, and the five bacterial indicators used in the article (38 C or higher, absence of cough, cervical node enlargement and tenderness, tonsillar enlargement or exudate, age 3-14). Visit volume: the NHIS health insurance statistics table for 2024 outpatient cases (KOSIS DT_A077111, as compiled by the reference site) gives 4,634,099 for acute pharyngitis J02, 4,732,044 for acute tonsillitis J03, 3,252,799 for acute laryngitis and tracheitis J04 and 17,288,343 for acute bronchitis J20; the article rounds these to 463만, 473만, 325만 and 1,728만 and the calculation is recorded in the research file. Povidone-iodine: the MFDS nedrug record for 베타딘인후스프레이 (item 201401964, OTC, licensed 2014-04-23) gives 0.450 g povidone-iodine per 100 mL as 0.045 g available iodine, indications of oral antisepsis plus pharyngitis, laryngitis and stomatitis, dosing of several sprays a day, contraindications in iodine hypersensitivity, thyroid dysfunction, children under 6 and around radioiodine therapy, a warning to consult in pregnancy and breastfeeding, a 4-week interval before thyroid scintigraphy, and headaches such as oral irritation and mucosal erosion as adverse effects. Propolis: the Functional Food Hub entry for propolis extract, quoting the Korean health functional food code, sets total flavonoids at 10 mg/g or more with p-coumaric acid and cinnamic acid confirmed, a daily intake of 20-40 mg total flavonoids, and the approved function claim of antioxidant and oral antibacterial action limited to products that contact the oral cavity. Trial: Esposito et al., Phytomedicine 2021;80:153368 randomized 122 adults with uncomplicated URTI to a standardized poplar propolis oral spray or placebo, sprayed two to four times three times daily for five days, and reported that on day 3 residual sore throat was 16% versus 68% (p<0.001), hoarseness 10% versus 71%, redness and swelling 18% versus 83%, no symptoms in either arm by day 5 and no adverse events; one author was an employee of the manufacturer. Doraji: Shin et al., Planta Medica 2002;68:221-225 showed platycodin D and D3 increased mucin release from cultured rat and hamster tracheal epithelium and intact rat trachea, and Zhang et al., J Chromatogr B 2021 reported that the saponin fraction reduced cough in an ammonia-induced mouse model; the article states these are animal and cell studies without a human cough trial. Saline: the 2019 randomized trial of 100 non-bacterial pharyngitis patients reported better sore throat, swallowing and swelling scores with 3% saline than with thymol (all p<0.001); the ELVIS pilot randomized trial (Scientific Reports 2019;9:1015) recruited 66 adults, analysed 61, and found a 1.9-day shorter illness (95% CI 0.4-3.3, p=0.01) and 2.4-day shorter cough (p=0.003) for hypertonic saline nasal irrigation plus gargling, with 80% using 3%, and the article labels it unblinded and small and does not attribute the effect to gargling alone. The NHS sore throat page (media last reviewed 14 July 2023) advises half a teaspoon of salt in a glass of warm water, gargle and spit, not for children, and to see a GP if it has not improved after a week; the salt concentration calculation (200 mL with 1.8 g for 0.9%, 6 g for 3%, 2.5 g half teaspoon for 1.25%) is recorded as a calculation in the research file. Products checked on Coupang on 2026-11-12: 콤비타 프로폴리스 스프레이 20 mL 1개 at 12,700 won after a 9% discount from 14,000 won, 3,166 reviews, free shipping with 11/14 arrival, ingredients listed as propolis extract, UMF10+ manuka honey 20%, glycerin, purified water, peppermint oil, star anise oil, myrrh oil and menthol, daily serving 2 mL, health functional food certified; the affiliate redirect was opened in the browser and landed on this exact item. The brief's 1st pick price of about 18,900 won was corrected to the current 12,700 won. [BETADINE] 베타딘 인후 스프레이 50 mL 2개 at 37,500 won (37,500 won per 100 mL), 12 reviews, free shipping with 11/26 arrival, which the article discloses while telling readers that a pharmacy is faster and cheaper for immediate use; the brief's 9,800 won figure does not match any domestic listing on Coupang, and no domestic 베타딘 인후스프레이 listing appeared in the searches, so the import listing is used with its real terms. 평생비책 강원도 약도라지청 13 g 30 sticks (390 g) at 29,900 won after a 40% time discount from 50,000 won, 4,736 reviews, more than 2,000 bought in the past month, next-day dawn delivery on 11/13, 997 won per stick; its mandatory disclosure lists the ingredient list as '상품 상세페이지 참조', which the article states openly. The brief's 3rd pick 정관장 굿베이스 홍삼담은 도라지배스틱 could not be found on Coupang; the closest 정관장 item was 수세미배도라지 80 mL 30포 at 80,850 won with 11/17 arrival, which is far outside the 1-2만원 gift range, so the best-selling domestic 약도라지청 stick at the brief's own 29,900 won price point replaced it. Category set to home, not the brief's living, because the site taxonomy defines living as household bill savings and its 38 existing health and home-care guides sit in home. Kakao Gift curator link reuses the live 오설록 프리미엄 티 컬렉션 card (bFGXVyDC) rather than minting a new link, because the curator dashboard challenges automated sessions; the gift section is framed around a warm tea gift for a colleague or parent with a sore throat, which matches that card. The five ranges that first rendered as number artifacts in the gate (40-50%, 18-22 C, 40-60%, 23.0-54.1%, 22.0-48.2%, 7-10 days, 30-40%, 10-20%, 50-75%) were rewritten as 'X에서 Y' so the numbers check cleanly; no tildes remain in the body. Verified no 진단/치료법/처방/복용법/부작용 wording in title, description, targetQuery, secondaryQueries or tags. Measured overlap with existing posts: body 16% with the winter scalp guide, title 41%, query 29%. Gate score 100/100.
